title: Question 27
passage:
Could you leave the felt pad in place after you take the display down?
A. The display stays up until Friday. B. Of course. I’ll take everything off except the pad. C. That felt is thicker than the one we used last year.
passageZh:
把展示拆下來後，可以把毛氈墊留在原位嗎？
A. 展示會保留到星期五。 B. 當然。我會把墊子以外的東西都拿掉。 C. 這塊毛氈比我們去年用的厚。
